newsitem.title: USA: Data Dimensions CFO and COO resign.
newsitem.headline: Data Dimensions CFO and COO resign.

text.p: Data Dimensions Inc said Thursday that William Parsons is stepping down as the company's chief financial officer but will continue on a consulting basis and Philip Newbold, the company's chief operating officer, has resigned to accept a position elsewhere.
Data Dimensions said that the search for a new CFO is currently underway and it is considering several strong candidates.
The company said that with its previously announced restructuring of the organization, the position of chief operating officer will no longer exist.
